\[

\]

\[

\]

The only way \(\exp\left( -\int_{t_0}^t p(s)\, ds \right)\) is constant is if the integral is constant, which implies:

\[
p(t) = 0
\]

for all \(t\).

Thus, the function is:

\[
\boxed{p(t) = 0}
